# GeoServer MCP

> A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes GeoServer's REST API as
> 80+ natural-language tools for AI assistants like Claude, VS Code Copilot,
> and other MCP-compatible clients. Also known as GeoServer Cloud MCP or
> geoservercloud-mcp.

GeoServer MCP wraps the python-geoservercloud library and lets an AI assistant
manage a GeoServer instance through plain language — no REST calls by hand.

## What it can do

- Workspaces: create, list, and manage workspaces
- Datastores: PostGIS, JNDI, PMTiles, and generic stores
- Layers & feature types: publish and manage vector layers
- Coverage & raster: coverage stores and ImageMosaic granules
- Styles: upload and assign SLD & MBStyle styles
- WMS / WMTS cascading: proxy external OGC services as layers
- Layer groups: compose and manage grouped layers
- Security & ACL: users, roles, and access-control rules
- GeoWebCache: manage tile caching for layers

## Install

- PyPI: `pip install geoservercloud-mcp`
- Run without installing (uv): `uvx geoservercloud-mcp`
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add geoserver -- uvx geoservercloud-mcp`
- MCP Registry name: `io.github.ronitjadhav/geoservercloud-mcp`
